fixedWEB.text: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

article.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
article.locator: § Joash, lines 4224–4234; specifically line 4232 on the Joash called “the king’s son” in Ahab’s time (read 2026-10-16T04:00:25Z)
article.paraphraseJa: 記事はアハブ時代の「王の子」ヨアシュを複数の同名ヨアシュの一人として扱う。ただし、彼が実子か高官の称号かは不確かだと明記する。WEB 1KI 22:26も「Amon the governor of the city and Joash the king’s son」と二人を別々に挙げる。現プロフィールsummaryの「王の家を預かるヨアシュの子ヨアシュ」は本文にない親子/役職の結合で、Amonの役職をヨアシュの父へ誤って移している。
article.recommendation: Wikipedia entry is suitable shared-section identity reference, identityVerified=true/relationVerified=false, gate 1KI 22:26; preserve article’s uncertainty whether “king’s son” is literal or title. Fail current profile reader summary until it is narrowed to the WEB wording. Suggested safe summary: “イスラエル王はミカヤを町の長官アモンと『王の子』ヨアシュへ引き渡すよう命じました。本文はヨアシュの父や職務を明らかにしません。”
article.basisJa: The verse distinguishes Amon governor from Joash king’s son. Wikipedia supports the matching Ahab-period referent but explicitly leaves the designation ambiguous.
article.primaryReaderFindingJa: current summary incorrectly joins Joash with the preceding Amon governor and makes Amon’s office into Joash’s father/role; fixed WEB provides no such relation.
